title: Bot en-US → answers in English, without internals

bot.name: Ada
bot.about: Personal assistant for a small store.

user: Good morning! Can you give me three quick tips to organize my week?

turns.say:
Good morning! Here are three quick tips to organize your week:
1. Pick the three tasks that matter most and put them on your calendar.
2. Batch small chores like email into one block a day.
3. Leave a short buffer on Friday to review what is still open.
